title: Silvio's own PromptUGAL agents: push access to PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website, and the names @PrompTugal.silvio
detail: Silvio wants three agents of his own on PromptUGAL: conductor@PrompTugal.silvio, journalist@PrompTugal.silvio and dev@PrompTugal.silvio. Two things only Dinis can give: (a) push access for Silvio's GitHub account riskmandate-silvio to PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website (today it can read, not write: checked 5 November); (b) a yes to a PromptUGAL namespace, <agent>@PrompTugal.<person>, beside <agent>@web-summit.<person> (no agent uses it yet). Their jobs are being agreed with Silvio; they follow newsroom@web-summit.dinis's rules for the site.
